courses.subject: BAH
courses.title: Topics in Business Administration Honors
courses.description: This course is used to record credit the student earns while enrolled at another institution in a program administered by the University's Study Abroad Office. Credit is recorded as assigned by the study abroad adviser in the School of Business. University credit is awarded for work in an exchange program; it may be counted as coursework taken in residence. Transfer credit is awarded for work in an affiliated studies program. May be repeated for credit when the topics vary.

courses.subject: BAH
courses.title: Lyceum
courses.description: Restricted to students admitted to the McCombs School of Business Honors Program. Observe professionals from various fields of business. One lecture hour a week for one semester. May be repeated for credit. Prerequisite: Business Administration 101H or 101S, or credit or registration for Business Administration 101T.
courses.prereqText: Business Administration 101H or 101S, or credit or registration for Business Administration 101T.
courses.restricted: Restricted to students admitted to the McCombs School of Business Honors Program.

courses.subject: BAH
courses.title: Independent Research
courses.description: Restricted to students admitted to the McCombs School of Business Honors Program. For each semester hour of credit earned, one lecture hour a week for one semester. Only one of the following may be counted: Accounting 379C, Business Administration Honors 379, Business, Government, and Society 379, Finance 379C, International Business 379C, Legal Environment of Business 379, Management 379C, Management Information Systems 379, Marketing 379C, Operations Management 379, Risk Management 379. Prerequisite: Sophomore standing, consent of instructor, and consent of the department chair.
